te: Odo, count of Paris, is crowned king of West Francia (France) by Archbishop Walter of Sens at Compiègne.
dz: 奥多(Odo)是巴黎伯爵,由森斯大主教瓦尔特(Walter of Sens at Compiègne)加冕为西弗朗西亚(法国)国王.
